newsitem.title: USA: Comprehensive Care expects Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Comprehensive Care expects Q1 loss.

text.p: Comprehensive Care Corp Monday said it expects to report a loss for the first quarter of fiscal 1997 ended in August comparable to the loss reported for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996.
The provider of care and care coordination of chronic and catastrophic diseases, reported a loss of $2.5 million or $0.94 a share for the fourth quarter.
In a statement, the company said its cash position has also shrunk to $2.8 million as of September 30 from $4.4 million on May 31.
The company said it also received $5.4 million related to its 1996 federal income tax return, representing the company's carryback of losses.

The company also announced the filing of an amended exchange offer and consent solicitation to the Securities and Exchange Commission related to the company's 7 1/2 percent convertible subordinated debentures. The company said the filings are pending final SEC review and approval.

The terms of the exchange offer are that for each $1,000 in debenture principal, the bondholder will receive $500 in cash and 16 shares of the company's common stock, and, in lieu of accrued interest, the holder will receive $80 plus eight additional shares of the company's common stock.
